ayahs.tr: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
And indeed, he is to that a witness.
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
ayahs.tl: Wa innahu lihubbil khairi la shadeed

ayahs.ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
ayahs.tr: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
ayahs.tl: Afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma filquboor

ayahs.tr: And that within the breasts is obtained,
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
ayahs.tl: Inna rabbahum bihim yauma 'izil la khabeer
